Title: Create a single user
Steps:
1. Send POST /user with valid user JSON
2. Verify response
Expected Result: Status 200. ApiResponse with message containing user ID.

Title: Create users with array
Steps:
1. Send POST /user/createWithArray with array of 2 user objects
2. Verify response

Title: Create users with list
Steps:
1. Send POST /user/createWithList with list of 1 user object
2. Verify response

Title: Login — valid credentials
Steps:
1. Send GET /user/login?username=qaengineer&password=Test@1234
2. Verify response contains session info
Expected Result: Status 200. Message includes 'logged in user session' with session token.

Title: Get user by username
Steps:
1. Send GET /user/{username}
2. Verify username, email, and other fields match
Expected Result: Status 200. User object with correct username, firstName, lastName, email.

Title: Update user
Steps:
1. Send PUT /user/{username} with updated email and phone
2. Verify response
3. Send GET /user/{username} to confirm
Expected Result: Status 200. Updated fields reflected on subsequent GET.

Title: Delete user
Expected Result: Status 200 on delete. Subsequent GET returns 404.
